name: Geode Health
one_liner: Psychiatry, therapy, TMS and esketamine in local offices or by video for children, teens and adults; takes insurance and Medicare.
best_for: People who want psychiatry and therapy from the same practice, in person or by video
People with depression that has not improved with medication who want to ask about TMS or esketamine
Families looking for psychiatric care for a child or teen
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who live far from a Geode office and need TMS or esketamine, which are given in person
People who want a published self-pay price before booking
short_description: Geode Health is an outpatient mental health practice offering psychiatry, therapy, TMS and esketamine, in person or by video.
long_description: Geode Health is an outpatient mental health practice with local offices. Psychiatrists, nurse practitioners and physician assistants diagnose and manage medication, therapists offer individual, couples and group therapy, and some offices provide transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) and esketamine for depression. Visits can be in person, by video or a mix. It sees children, teens and adults. It takes most major insurance plans, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna and UnitedHealthcare, plus Medicare; self-pay is available and HSA/FSA funds can be used. In Texas it is the mental health partner of the Baylor Scott & White health system. Which states it operates in, and its self-pay prices, could not be confirmed. There are no published studies of Geode's own service.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance or Medicare; self-pay available (price not published)
pricing.notes: Accepts most major plans including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna and UnitedHealthcare, plus Medicare. HSA and FSA funds accepted.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says Geode does not sell, rent or lease its customer lists and shares data only with service providers, and uses browsing data for ads within Geode, but the site cookie notice says cookies personalize ads and the policy never clearly rules out ad-partner sharing; deletion on verified request.

faqs.q: What is Geode Health and who is it for?
faqs.a: Geode Health is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.

faqs.q: How much does Geode Health cost?
faqs.a: Geode Health pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.

faqs.q: Is Geode Health covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

patient_summary: You book a psychiatry or therapy appointment and see your clinician at a local Geode office, by video, or both. It bills most major insurance plans and Medicare; self-pay is possible, but prices are not published. Some offices also offer TMS or esketamine for depression that hasn't responded to other treatment.

availability.note: In-person care only near Geode offices; video visits also offered. Texas availability confirmed through Baylor Scott & White; other states not verified.
